description.zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The application ID. This ID is generated when you create the application in the console. The ID contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.

description.zh:
禁言时长，单位：秒。

- 如果不填写该字段，默认禁言30秒。

- 传0表示永久禁言。

- 最大值不得超过24小时，如果超过，会被限制为24小时。
description.en:
The mute duration. Unit: seconds.

- If this parameter is not specified, the default mute duration is 30 seconds.

- A value of 0 indicates a permanent mute.

- The maximum value cannot exceed 24 hours. If the value exceeds 24 hours, it is automatically set to 24 hours.
The user ID of the user to be muted.

description.zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回。
description.en: The unique identifier of the room, returned when you call the CreateRoom operation.

description.zh: 操作人的用户ID，用于表示谁执行了禁言操作。
description.en: The user ID of the operator, which indicates who performed the mute operation.
